title: Designing Resilient Autonomous Systems with the Reflex Pattern
problem: Maintaining system resilience in autonomous systems under fluctuating resource availability and unstable environments. Traditional redundancy strategies are inefficient for dynamic resource constraints.
motivation: Autonomous systems face variable computational resources and environmental uncertainty; static redundancy cannot adapt dynamically to preserve essential functionality.
method: The system works like a biological reflex: when computing resources are plentiful, it runs complex algorithms, but when resources become scarce, it automatically switches to simpler, resource-efficient ones instead. ReflexLang is a specialized programming tool that automatically generates the code for this switching behavior.
key_novelty: Instead of pre-planning backups for every possible scenario, the reflex pattern lets systems automatically pick the right algorithm based on current resource availability.
contributions: Reflex pattern design methodology for resilient autonomous systems
ReflexLang DSL for automated reflex-based code generation
Validated on drone image processing demonstrating resilience under constraints
limitations: Evaluation limited to drone image processing scenario; generalization to other autonomous domains not discussed.
